IpAccessControl._comment: Disabled by default so this never accidentally locks anyone out. Set Enabled=true and populate AllowedIPs (exact IPs, CIDR ranges like '203.0.113.0/24', or 'localhost') before relying on this. Leave ProtectedPathPrefixes empty to protect the whole app, or list prefixes like '/Admin' to restrict just those areas.

Google._comment: Do not put real values here. Set via `dotnet user-secrets set "Authentication:Google:ClientId" "..."` in development, or the Authentication__Google__ClientId / Authentication__Google__ClientSecret environment variables in production. Google sign-in is inactive while these are empty.

DisposableEmail._comment: Optional extra domains to block at registration, merged with the built-in default list in Services/DisposableEmailService.cs. No API key/secret needed — this is a local, config-driven blocklist, not an external service. Add entries here for routine additions instead of editing the C# file.

Azure._comment: Reserved for future use — not read anywhere in this codebase today (file storage is local disk via Services/FileStorageService.cs). Set via User Secrets / Azure__StorageConnectionString env var / Key Vault if this is ever wired up.

Jwt._comment: Reserved for future use — not read anywhere in this codebase today (auth is cookie-based). Set via User Secrets / Jwt__SigningKey env var / Key Vault if this is ever wired up. Never commit a real signing key here.
